Container.Name: site-manager-public
Container.Overview:
Site Manager - Public Read-Only Interface
Read-only public version of Site Manager for safely sharing your resume, CV, or portfolio site. Intended for Cloudflare Tunnel, reverse proxy, or internal public-view access. Write operations are blocked in public-only mode.
PUBLIC VERSION - Install Site Manager (Admin) first, then install this template if you want a separate public container. Use the same AppData and Uploads paths as the Admin container so both containers share the same database and media files.
Default ports: Admin 3010, Public 3011.
Container.Requires: Install Site Manager (Admin) first and use the same AppData and Uploads paths.

Config.Name: Public WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port for the public read-only interface. Change this if port 3011 is already in use.

Config.Name: AppData
Config.Description: Database storage mounted read-only. IMPORTANT: Use the same path as the Site Manager Admin container.

Config.Name: Uploads
Config.Description: Uploaded images and media mounted read-only. IMPORTANT: Use the same path as the Site Manager Admin container.

Config.Name: DB Path
Config.Description: Path to the SQLite database inside the container. Leave as default unless you know you need a custom path.

Config.Name: Public Port (internal)
Config.Description: Internal app port. Do not change this; change Public WebUI Port above if you need a different host port.

Config.Name: Public Only Mode
Config.Description: Forces read-only public mode. Keep true for this public template.
